rules.text: 90 days for most items (in-store and Walmart.com).
rules.quote: You have 90 days after purchase or upon receipt to return most items unless noted in our exceptions.

rules.text: Items sold and shipped by Marketplace sellers: 30 days.
rules.quote: Items sold and shipped by a Marketplace seller may be returned within 30 days.
Most Consumer Electronics are returnable within 30 days.
Wireless phones are returnable within 14 days.

rules.text: Most items bought Oct 1–Dec 31 are returnable until Jan 31. Marketplace seller participation varies.
rules.quote: Most items purchased in-store or online from October 1 through December 31 are returnable until January 31.
rules.reviewNote: The summary adds 'Marketplace seller participation varies,' which is not stated in the quote. The quote only covers Walmart in-store and online purchases.

rules.text: Items bought from dealers or resellers (not Walmart directly) are not eligible.
rules.quote: Items purchased from dealers or resellers and not Walmart or Walmart.com directly aren't eligible for return, refund, or exchange.

rules.text: Certain items such as firearms, ammunition, prescription medications, and others are not returnable or refundable.
rules.quote:
To help keep our customers and associates safe Walmart and Marketplace sellers will not replace, accept returns, or provide refunds for:

| Firearms & Ammunition | Prescription Medications and Devices | 
| Airsoft & Air Guns, BB Guns, Crossbows, Vertical / Archery bows | Items containing pseudoephedrine, ephedrine, phenylpropanolamine | 
| Pepper Spray/Bear Spray | Sex Toys & Vibrators, Pregnancy Tests, Ovulation Tests, & Home Diagnostic Testing Kits (including COVID-19 tests) | 
| Gas Powered Recreational Vehicles (e. g., Dirt Bikes, Mini-Bikes, Go-Carts, Scooters, Ride-ons, UTVs & ATVs) | Diabetic Supplies* including meters, strips, lancets, lancet devices & syringes | 
| Used or Mounted Tires, Wheels, Rims, Snow Tires | Hygienic Medical Equipment (e.g., bedpans, bath seats, sitz baths, eye drop guides, opened/unsealed breast pumps) | 
| Trading cards (opened or unopened) | RV sewer lines, toilets, toilet bowls and urinals (used or installed) | 
| Precious Metals (e.g., gold bars, coins, currency) | Special orders made through Walmart Business | 
| Alcohol (Wine, Spirits, Beer) | Tobacco Products | 
| Prepaid Cell Phone Cards, Prepaid Gaming Cards, Gift cards, SIM Cards | Video on Demand, Downloadable Video Games/Software |

rules.text: Automotive batteries can be refunded or exchanged if they test bad within 90 days of purchase.
rules.quote: **90-Day Automotive Battery Guarantee:** Money back refund or exchange to original purchaser if battery tests bad within 90 days.

rules.text: Major appliances can be returned for a full refund within 2 days of accepted delivery; after 2 days, returns are subject to guidelines.
rules.quote: A customer may initiate a return of a major appliance for a full refund within 2 days of accepted delivery.
rules.reviewNote: The summary adds 'after 2 days, returns are subject to guidelines,' which is not stated in the quote. The quote only mentions a full refund within 2 days.
